$comment: Audit station: adversarial check of one line item across necessity, quantity, policy, duplicates, and budget reasonableness. Survivors are items with real==true and non-empty evidence.
title: ShoppingAuditVerdict

id.$comment: Must match the line item id under review.

real.$comment: true only when the line should proceed to procurement; false drops the item from survivors.

necessity.$comment: Is this needed for office operations this cycle?

quantity_sane.$comment: Is quantity proportional to headcount / burn rate?

not_duplicate.$comment: Not already covered by another line or recent purchase.

budget_reasonable.$comment: Plausible spend for a small office cycle.

evidence.$comment: Independent citations supporting the verdict. Empty array drops the item even if real were true.
